transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi Sarah. My name is Michael Moore. I'm calling because I need to order some new mobile lines and devices for my company.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, Michael, I can certainly try to help you with that. Are you calling about an existing Cymbal Telecom business account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, this would be a new account for the business. The company is Telecom Personal. I personally have a residential account with you for my home internet, but this is separate.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I see. Thank you for clarifying. I'm on the residential services team, but I can definitely get you to the right place. To start, since you mentioned your personal account, would you mind if I pull it up? It might be helpful for reference. Can I get your customer ID or phone number?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sure, that's fine. My customer ID is CUST-1019.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. And for security, can you please verify the 4-digit security PIN on the account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, thank you. I have your account pulled up now. I see you have our Fiber 300 internet service. Thank you for being a Cymbal customer.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You're welcome. It's been great. Now, about these business lines... I really don't want to get transferred and have to wait on hold again if I can avoid it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand. While our Business Solutions team will need to finalize the order, perhaps I can help with some preliminary information first. What exactly were you looking to set up today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That would be fantastic, thank you. I'm an IT representative for my company, and we need to equip our field crew. I'm looking to get 10 new mobile lines, and each line needs to be paired with an LTE-capable tablet.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Ten lines with tablets. Okay. I can definitely look into some options for you. Do you have an idea of how much data each field technician might use per month?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Good question. They use a proprietary app for work orders which pulls map data, and they upload photos of completed jobs. I would estimate somewhere in the range of 15 to 20 gigabytes a month, per person, to be safe.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, 15-20GB per line. Let me just pull up our business rate plans. One moment please.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, thanks for your patience. It looks like we have a few plans that could work. Our most popular one for needs like yours is the 'Cymbal Business Pro' plan.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, what does 'Business Pro' include?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The Business Pro plan comes with 50 gigabytes of premium high-speed data per line. If a user goes over 50GB, the data is still unlimited but may be slowed down during times of network congestion. It also includes 15GB of high-speed hotspot data.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Fifty gigabytes is more than enough. That sounds like a good fit. What's the pricing structure for something like that?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Business pricing is tiered based on the number of lines. For an account with 6 to 20 lines, the Business Pro plan is $45 per line, per month. That price includes a discount for enrolling in autopay and paperless billing.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So, for ten lines, that would be $450 a month, plus taxes and fees. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is correct. $450 per month before any applicable taxes or government fees.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Alright, that seems reasonable. Now, what about the tablets? We need something reliable for field use, but we're also conscious of the budget.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course. Let me check the device catalog for you. We have a range of options. The most common choice for this kind of deployment is the Samsung Galaxy Tab A series with LTE.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, the Galaxy Tab A... is that a durable device?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's a standard consumer-grade tablet, quite reliable. We do also partner with manufacturers for more rugged, construction-site-proof models, but they are significantly more expensive.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Let's stick with the standard one for now. We'll get protective cases for them. What would the cost be for ten of those tablets?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me check for current promotions. It's often more advantageous to see what offers are available when activating new lines... Okay, I'm seeing a great promotion right now.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh? What is it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: For new business customers who activate a line on a plan like the Business Pro, we are offering a Samsung Galaxy Tab A 'on us' via monthly bill credits.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Wait, 'on us'? As in... free?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Effectively, yes. The way it works is you would purchase the device on a 36-month device payment agreement. Then, each month, you would see a bill credit for the exact amount of the monthly payment, making the net cost for the tablet zero dollars, as long as the line remains active for the full 36 months.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: And that offer applies to all ten lines if I sign up?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, the offer terms state it's for each new qualifying line added. So you could get ten tablets with ten new lines.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Wow. Okay, that's... that's a fantastic deal. So my only monthly cost would be the $450 for the service, plus taxes?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's right. Your bill would show the monthly charge for each tablet, and then an equal and opposite credit, so they cancel each other out.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: This is very promising. What other costs are involved? There must be activation fees or something.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are correct. There is a standard one-time activation fee of $35 for each new line.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, so for ten lines, that's a $350 upfront cost. Is that negotiable?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Typically the fee is standard, but for a bulk corporate order like this, our Business Solutions specialists sometimes have the ability to offer a credit to offset those fees. I can't personally apply that, but I can make a strong note on the account recommending it.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: If you could do that, I'd really appreciate it. A $350 savings would be a great way to start our relationship.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I've already added a note to the file I'm building for you. 'Customer ordering 10 new Business Pro lines, requesting waiver of activation fees as a bulk order incentive.'

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Perfect, thank you Sarah.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're welcome, Michael.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So, next question: logistics. How do we get the devices? And how do I manage all these lines?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We would ship the 10 tablets and the corresponding SIM cards directly to your business address. The SIMs can even be pre-installed if you'd like.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That would be ideal. And the management part?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Once your account is created, you'll be set up with access to the Cymbal Business Control Center. It's a web portal where you, as the administrator, can see everything in one place.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: What can I do in this portal?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can monitor data usage for each individual line, you can temporarily suspend a line if a device is lost, you can add or remove features, and you can view and pay your consolidated bill. It gives you full control over your fleet.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's exactly what I need. A single dashboard is much better than trying to manage ten individual accounts.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely. It's designed specifically for businesses like yours.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay. I'm sold. This all sounds perfect. What's the next step to make this happen?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: This is the point where I'll need to get you over to our Business Solutions team. As I mentioned, they need to officially create the new business account and process the order.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Right. So you're going to transfer me now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can do one better than a blind transfer. How about I gather a bit more information, create a detailed ticket with everything we've discussed, and have a dedicated Business Specialist call you back directly? That way you skip the queue and speak with an expert who already has all the details.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: A direct call back? That sounds like a great idea. I won't have to explain everything all over again?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Not at all. I've documented everything: the 10 Business Pro lines at $45 each, the promotional offer for 10 Samsung tablets, your request for the activation fee waiver, and the need for the Business Control Center. The specialist will have all of my notes.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sarah, you've been incredibly helpful. Yes, let's do that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. I just need to gather a few more details for the business account setup. Can I get the legal name of the business?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: It's 'Telecom Personal Inc.'

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Telecom Personal Inc. Got it. And the business address where the devices should be shipped?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's 1550 Corporate Boulevard, Suite 300, in Springfield.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And the zip code?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, 1550 Corporate Boulevard, Suite 300, Springfield, 62704. And what is the best callback number for the specialist to reach you at?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: They can call my direct line. It's 555-891-3496.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: 555-891-3496. Noted. The specialist will also likely need your company's Tax ID or EIN to set up the account. Do you have that handy?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I do, but I'd rather provide that directly to the business specialist when they call, for security reasons.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a very wise precaution, and perfectly fine. I'll just note that the specialist will need to collect it from you. Our specialists typically call back within one to two business hours. Are you available for the rest of the afternoon?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, I'll be at my desk. A call within the hour would be ideal, but two hours is fine.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. I'm just finalizing the ticket now... Okay, it's all submitted. I have a reference ticket number for you, if you'd like it.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, please.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your reference number is B-S-L, as in Business Solutions Lead, followed by the number 77042.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: BSL77042. Got it. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I just want to confirm one more time, the tablets are the Samsung Galaxy Tab A, the LTE version, correct?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, that's correct. The promotion is for the Samsung Galaxy Tab A, model SM-T295, which is the LTE-enabled version.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great. And the 36-month term is firm? There's no 24-month option for the device credits?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me double-check the terms... Yes, the promotional credits are specifically tied to a 36-month device payment agreement. If you were to cancel a line before 36 months, the remaining balance on that specific tablet would become due.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that's important to know. We plan to keep the service, but it's good to understand the commitment. Thank you for checking.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course. It's better to have all the details upfront. The Business Specialist who calls you will also go over the official agreement with you line by line before you commit to anything.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's good to hear. I've had experiences with other providers where things get... confused.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We try our best to be transparent. I've made sure my notes are extremely detailed so there should be no confusion when John or another specialist from the business team calls you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Who is John?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Oh, sorry, John is one of our senior specialists on the business team. I was just thinking he's likely the one who will pick up a ticket like this. It could be any of our qualified specialists, though.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Understood. As long as they have the notes, it doesn't matter to me.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: They will.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Another quick question. The data... is the 50GB of premium data usable in Canada or Mexico?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's an excellent question. Let me check the plan details for that specific feature. One moment...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, thank you for waiting. Yes, the Business Pro plan includes unlimited talk, text, and data within and between the US, Mexico, and Canada. Your team can use their data in North America without any roaming charges.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's a huge bonus. We occasionally have projects that take us across the border. That simplifies things immensely.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm glad to hear that. It's a great feature of the plan.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: And the hotspot data, the 15GB you mentioned. Is that also usable in Canada and Mexico?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, it is. The high-speed hotspot allowance can also be used in North America.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Fantastic.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else I can clarify for you while you're waiting for the specialist's call?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I don't think so. You've covered the plan, the device, the costs, the management portal, and the next steps. This has been far more productive than I expected.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm so happy I could help, Michael. Even from the residential department.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You should tell your manager they need to give you a raise. It's rare to get someone this helpful who is willing to step outside their exact role.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's very kind of you to say. I really appreciate that. I just enjoy making sure customers get the help they need.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Well, you certainly did that today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So, just to recap one last time for my own peace of mind: I've created lead ticket BSL77042 for a Business Specialist to call you back at 555-891-3496 to set up a new account for Telecom Personal Inc. The request is for 10 Business Pro lines with the promotional Samsung tablets, with a note to waive activation fees.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That is a perfect summary. You've got it all.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. Then you should be all set. The specialist will handle everything from here.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I can't thank you enough, Sarah.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It has been my absolute pleasure, Michael. Before we disconnect, is there anything I can help you with regarding your personal Fiber 300 internet service?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, the internet is working great. That's all I needed today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright then. We look forward to welcoming Telecom Personal Inc. to the Cymbal Telecom family. Thank you for choosing us for your business needs.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thanks to you, it was an easy choice.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. Have a wonderful afternoon, and expect that call soon!

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too, Sarah. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.
